pack.name: Bedrock Essentials
pack.description: Feature collection: JEI recipe browser, clan system, Java saturation, Carry On
be.main.title: Bedrock Essentials
be.main.body: Every mini add-on, one button per feature. Sneak + use the compass to toggle clan chat.
be.about.title: About
be.about.body: Bedrock Essentials bundles several features in one addon. Each feature has its own menu and settings.
food.body: With a full hunger bar, saturation heals one health point every half second (as in Java Edition). From 18 hunger it heals every 4 seconds. Symbols: ♥ health, ● hunger, ◆ saturation.
food.hud.on: Show values in the action bar
food.hud.off: Hide values in the action bar
food.status.on: Java saturation: healing from saturation active
be.feature.carry.desc: Carry chests, spawners, animals and players
carry.body: Sneak + empty hand on a chest, furnace, spawner, animal or player picks it up. Tap a block to put it down there. Contents and data are kept. Carried players get off by sneaking.
carry.rule.blocks.tile: Only blocks with contents/data (chests, furnaces, spawners ...)
carry.msg.carried: %s is carrying you. Sneak to get off.
carry.msg.dropped: You died - what you carried lies at the death spot.
carry.err.off: This is disabled in this world.
carry.err.not_tile: Only blocks with contents or data can be carried.
carry.err.hostile: Carrying monsters is disabled in this world.
carry.err.crowded: Too crowded - another creature shares this block cell.
carry.status.tile: Carry On: blocks with contents, creatures, players
carry.status.all: Carry On: all blocks, creatures, players
be.feature.clan.desc: Clans, roles, chat, bank, levels, clan home
clan.disabled: The clan system is disabled in this world.
clan.noclan: You are not in a clan. Found one or get invited.
clan.hud.warmup: Teleport in %s s - do not move
clan.field.name: Name (%s-%s characters)
clan.field.motd.placeholder: Shown to members when they join the world
clan.info.open: Open - you can request to join.
clan.info.requested: Request sent, waiting for an answer
clan.invites.body: Tap an invitation to accept or decline it.
clan.invite.body: Tap a player to invite them. ● is online, ○ offline - the invite then waits for them.
clan.invite.none: No known player without a clan.
clan.requests.body: Tap a request to handle it.
clan.bank.body: %s of %s slots used, %s items in total
clan.bank.pick: Pick an item from your inventory (✘ = cannot be stored).
clan.home.rules: Warm-up %s s · cooldown %s s · combat lock %s s
clan.stats.line: %s kills (%s players) · %s deaths · %s blocks · %s min playtime
clan.settings.body.leader: As the leader you can change everything.
clan.settings.body.officer: As an officer you can change the message of the day.
clan.confirm.disband: Really disband clan %s? Bank, level and log will be lost.
clan.confirm.transfer: Really hand leadership to %s? You will become an officer.
clan.confirm.reset: Really delete ALL clans? Admin settings are kept.
clan.msg.invited: You were invited to clan %s (by %s). Compass → Clans → My invitations.
clan.msg.accepted: Your request was accepted - welcome to clan %s!
clan.msg.request: %s wants to join the clan. Compass → Clans → Join requests.
clan.msg.bankCleared: Bank cleared, %s items handed to you.
clan.msg.home.warmup: Teleport in %s s - do not move.
clan.msg.pendingRequests: Your clan has %s pending join request(s).
clan.err.disabled: This feature is disabled in this world.
clan.err.no_clan: You are not in a clan.
clan.err.already_in_clan: You are already in a clan.
clan.err.max_clans: The maximum number of clans has been reached.
clan.err.name_length: The name has the wrong length.
clan.err.tag_length: The tag has the wrong length.
clan.err.tag_chars: The tag may only contain letters and digits.
clan.err.no_permission: You do not have permission for that.
clan.err.self: You cannot do that to yourself.
clan.err.target_in_clan: That player is already in a clan.
clan.err.not_invited: You are not (or no longer) invited.
clan.err.not_open: This clan does not accept requests.
clan.err.not_member: Not a member of this clan.
clan.err.is_leader: The leader cannot leave - transfer leadership or disband first.
clan.err.combat: You were in combat just now - %s s left.
clan.err.already_pending: A teleport is already in progress.
clan.err.item_unsupported: This item cannot be stored (contents or data would be lost).
clan.admin.body: Every component can be switched off individually; all values are adjustable. Changes apply to the whole world immediately.
clan.admin.feature.chat: Clan chat (channel, prefix, tag in chat)
clan.admin.chat.prefix: Chat prefix for the clan channel
clan.field.message: Message (only clan members will see it)
be.feature.combat.desc: Attack cooldown, sweep attack, Java damage, PvP
combat.body: Melee like Java Edition: every weapon recharges after a hit – attacking early deals only 20–100 % damage. Swords hit every enemy nearby when fully charged (sweep attack). Critical hits only while falling with full charge and no sprint. Swords deal 1 HP less, axes 3–4 HP more; axes disable shields for 5 seconds. Note: a hit that kills with Bedrock damage stays lethal.
combat.rule.crits: Crit only at full charge, not while sprinting
combat.msg.ally: %1 is in your clan – no damage.
combat.msg.pvpfail: The pvp game rule could not be set.
be.feature.trade.desc: Public or private offers, mailbox, live trading
trade.body: Offer items from your inventory and ask for something in return – publicly on the market or privately to one player. The other side need not be online: payment, goods and messages go to the mailbox.
trade.summary: Market: %1 · For you: %2 · Your offers: %3 · Mailbox: %4 items
trade.market.empty: No public offers yet. Create the first one!
trade.detail.title: Offer
trade.confirm.accept: Accept this offer? The payment is taken from your inventory and the goods arrive right away (mailbox if they don't fit).
trade.gift: Give it away - ask for nothing
trade.gift.hint: The recipient simply takes it, no payment
trade.want.body: What do you want in return? Without one the offer becomes a gift.
trade.draft.body: Up to %1 stacks per offer. Items are taken from your inventory when the offer is created and held safely; after %2 days an open offer returns to your mailbox.
trade.target.body: ● online · ○ offline – offline players see the offer when they next join.
trade.pick.body: Pick an item from your inventory (✘ = cannot be held).
trade.want.searchHint: Part of the name is enough - add-on items too
trade.want.results: %1 result(s), closest first - tap an item or keep typing.
trade.mail.left: %1 do not fit into your inventory and stay in the mailbox.
trade.mail.body: %1 delivery(ies), %2 item(s) – Collect puts them into your inventory.
trade.live.body: Choose an online player. They get a request and accept it here in the menu.
trade.live.hint: Items stay in the inventory until the swap. Any change resets both confirmations. Reopen the window to see your partner's side.
trade.live.title: Trade with %1
trade.msg.expired: Your offer (%1) expired – the goods are in your mailbox.
trade.msg.newOffer: %1 made you a private offer (Trading → For me).
trade.msg.removedByOp: %1 removed your offer – the goods are in your mailbox.
trade.msg.countered: %1 declined your offer and is making a counter-offer (Trading → For me).
trade.msg.declined: %1 declined your offer – the goods are in your mailbox.
trade.msg.toMail: %1 item(s) are in your mailbox (inventory full).
trade.msg.joinSummary: Trading: %1 offer(s) for you, %2 item(s) in your mailbox.
trade.msg.declinedByYou: Offer declined – the seller gets the goods back.
trade.msg.liveRequest: %1 wants to trade with you (Trading → Live trade).
trade.msg.liveStarted: %1 accepted your trade request (Trading → Live trade).
trade.msg.liveConfirmed: %1 confirmed – confirm as well (Trading → Live trade).
trade.msg.liveTimeout: Trade cancelled after 5 minutes of inactivity.
trade.ev.expired: Your offer (%1) expired – the goods are in your mailbox.
trade.ev.removed: %1 removed your offer (%2) – the goods are in your mailbox.
trade.ev.countered: %1 declined your offer (%2) and made a counter-offer.
trade.ev.declined: %1 declined your offer (%2) – the goods are in your mailbox.
trade.err.item_gone: An item is no longer in your inventory – selection reset.
trade.err.item_unsupported: This item cannot be held (shulker box, book, map, potion …).
trade.err.no_permission: You are not allowed to do that.
trade.err.not_for_you: This offer is addressed to someone else.
trade.err.cannot_pay: You do not have the requested items.
trade.err.busy: One of you is already trading.
be.feature.waila.desc: Name and addon of the block or entity you look at
waila.body: Shows what you are looking at in the action bar: name, origin (Minecraft or addon) and extras like growth, redstone signal or health – like WAILA/Jade on Java. Holding a spyglass additionally shows chest contents, furnace slots and sign text.
waila.status.on: What Am I Looking At: active
waila.status.off: What Am I Looking At: off
be.feature.sit.desc: Sit on stairs, slabs and carpets
sit.body: Empty hand + tap a stair, bottom slab or carpet to sit on it. Sneak to stand up.
be.feature.inv.desc: Sort and stash into nearby chests
inv.body: Sort merges stacks in the main inventory and orders them (hotbar and armor stay). Stash puts stacks into chests, barrels and shulker boxes within %1 blocks that already contain the same item.
inv.msg.stashed: Stashed %1 item(s) in %2 stacks (%3 containers nearby).
inv.err.no_container: No chest, barrel or shulker box nearby.
be.feature.treecap.desc: Break one log with an axe – the whole tree falls
treecap.body.sneak: Sneak + axe: breaking a log fells the whole connected trunk of that wood type (up to %1 blocks). The axe loses one durability point per block.
treecap.body.always: Axe: breaking a log fells the whole connected trunk of that wood type (up to %1 blocks). The axe loses one durability point per block.
be.feature.stats.desc: Your numbers with rank and leaderboards
stats.body: %1 players tracked. Tap a stat for its leaderboard.
stats.reset.confirm: Really delete the statistics of all players?
be.feature.bounty.desc: Put items on a player's head – the hunter collects
bounty.body: Put items on a player. Whoever kills them receives all bounties (mailbox if the inventory is full). Your own bounties can be withdrawn.
bounty.confirm: Place a bounty on %1? The items are taken from your inventory.
bounty.msg.removed: %1 removed your bounty (%2) – the items are in your mailbox.
bounty.msg.toMail: %1 item(s) are in your mailbox (inventory full).
bounty.err.no_permission: You are not allowed to do that.
bounty.err.item_gone: The item is no longer in your inventory.
be.modules.body: Every feature of Bedrock Essentials is a mini add-on and can be switched on and off here. Off means: no button in the main menu, no display, no events – the data is kept. Active: %1 of %2.
be.modules.allOn.confirm: Switch all mini add-ons back on?
be.feature.artifacts.desc: 40 trinkets in four rarities across five slots
artifacts.body: Artifacts are worn in their own slots (Bedrock has no equipment slots for them). Equip them here – the item moves from your inventory into the slot. You find them from monsters (chance per rarity) and always from mimics.
artifacts.cosmetic: Cosmetic mode: artifacts have no effect.
artifacts.slot.head: Head
artifacts.slot.choose: Pick an artifact from your inventory.
artifacts.slot.none: You have no artifact for this slot.
artifacts.slot.hint: Tap to equip another artifact, ✘ takes it off.
artifacts.equip.body: Artifacts in your inventory – tap to equip.
artifacts.equip.none: You are not carrying an artifact.
artifacts.collection.body: All %1 artifacts. ◆ equipped · ◇ yellow in inventory · ◇ grey not found yet.
artifacts.give.body: Put an artifact into your inventory. As a command: /give @s essentials:<id>
artifacts.cfg.hud.on: Show the count in the action bar
artifacts.cfg.hud.off: Hide the count in the action bar
artifacts.rule.scatterShare: Stray find: share of the values above (%)
artifacts.rule.mobSpecific: Artifacts only from their own mob
artifacts.collection.sources: ⚑ Source. Every hostile mob can very rarely drop anything else as well.
artifacts.msg.scatter: Stray find! Nothing was meant to drop here:
artifacts.msg.egg: The dragon egg carries the dragon's power - take it:
artifacts.origin.first_dragon: The egg of the first ender dragon
artifacts.msg.dropped: %1 artifact(s) lie at your death spot.
artifacts.look.body: Choose which artifacts others can see on you. The effects always stay – this is about looks only.
artifacts.look.allOn.confirm: Show all hidden artifacts on your body again?
artifacts.look.nopack: The two cosmetic packs are not active – nothing is visible right now anyway.
artifacts.err.legendary_limit: You already wear as many legendary artifacts as the operator allows.
artifacts.desc.night_vision_goggles: You can see in the dark.
artifacts.desc.snorkel: Water breathing while you are in water.
artifacts.desc.flame_pendant: 40 % chance to set the attacker on fire.
artifacts.desc.shock_pendant: 15 % chance to strike the attacker with lightning.
artifacts.desc.panic_necklace: Speed II for 5 seconds after being hit.
artifacts.desc.obsidian_skull: Fire resistance for 30 seconds after fire damage (60 second cooldown).
artifacts.desc.power_glove: Your melee hits deal 2 hearts more damage.
artifacts.desc.vampiric_glove: You heal 20 % of the melee damage you deal.
artifacts.desc.fire_gauntlet: Your melee hits set enemies on fire.
artifacts.desc.bunny_hoppers: Higher jumps and no fall damage.
artifacts.desc.kitty_slippers: Creepers within 8 blocks are pushed away.
artifacts.desc.villager_mask: Villagers treat you as a hero and trade cheaper.
artifacts.desc.spark_core: Ores within 6 blocks sparkle every 2 seconds.
artifacts.desc.guardian_crown: Permanent night vision and water breathing, plus conduit power underwater.
artifacts.desc.cross_necklace: After a heavy hit, 5 seconds of resistance (5 minute cooldown).
artifacts.desc.invisibility_scarf: Invisible while you stand still – your armour stays visible.
artifacts.desc.lucky_scarf: Doubles every drop chance for artifacts.
artifacts.desc.echo_heart: Stores 20 % of the damage you take and passes it on with your next hit.
artifacts.desc.phoenix_feather: Saves you at low health: heals you to 6 hearts (5 minute cooldown).
artifacts.desc.antidote_vessel: Poison and wither end after 3 seconds.
artifacts.desc.helium_flamingo: Hold jump in mid-air to float for 4 seconds (20 second cooldown).
artifacts.desc.everlasting_steak: Refills half a drumstick every 10 seconds.
artifacts.desc.dragon_heart: 8 extra hearts that always stay - plus regeneration out of combat.
artifacts.desc.dragon_egg: Aura, end leap, dragon breath, 4 extra hearts - but endermen turn on you
artifacts.carry.hint: Works as soon as it is in your inventory - it is never equipped
artifacts.desc.umbrella: You fall gently while your off hand is empty.
artifacts.desc.pocket_piston: Your hits knock enemies far back.
artifacts.desc.feral_claws: Your attacks recharge 40 % faster (needs the combat module).
artifacts.desc.golden_hook: 25 % chance for emeralds from slain monsters.
artifacts.desc.void_glove: Your hits fling the target 6 blocks away, plus 15 % lifesteal.
artifacts.desc.steadfast_spikes: Cactus, berries and magma blocks no longer hurt you.
artifacts.desc.aqua_dashers: Water freezes under your feet while you sprint.
artifacts.desc.storm_striders: Triple jump, no fall damage, a shockwave on landing that throws enemies back (up to 6 blocks).
be.feature.revive.desc: Those who fall go down first and can still be saved
revive.body: Instead of dying you go down: marked, barely able to move, but invulnerable. You have %1 seconds. Another player stands next to you and holds sneak for %2 seconds – then you are back on your feet.
revive.down.hint: Another player has to stand next to you and sneak. You can barely move, and right now you cannot die.
revive.giveup.confirm: Really give up? You die right away and leave your things here.
revive.msg.down: %1 is down at %2 and needs help! %3 seconds left.
revive.msg.self: Hold on! Another player has to sneak next to you to get you up.
revive.msg.hurry: %1 is still down at %3 – only %2 seconds left!
revive.msg.up: %1 is back on their feet – saved by %2.
revive.msg.logout: You logged out while down – that counts as a death.
revive.rule.threshold: Threshold: health at which you go down
be.feature.tetra.desc: Build and hone tools, weapons and armour from modules
be.feature.totem.desc: Imprint and upgrade totems of undying at the altar
totem.title: Totem altar
totem.body.none: Hold a totem of undying in your hand.
totem.body.plain: An unimprinted totem. It saves you as usual - an imprint adds what happens while it does.
totem.imprint.body: The imprint stays on the totem until you overwrite it. The look does not change - Bedrock ties the rescue to the vanilla totem.
totem.list.body: Eight imprints with %1 levels each. Line 3 names the material and the amount for level I · II · III, line 4 the first effect value.
totem.imprint.flame.desc: Fire resistance, and everything nearby catches fire
totem.imprint.frost.desc: Enemies nearby turn slow and weak
totem.imprint.storm.desc: A shockwave throws everything back, you fall gently
totem.imprint.heal.desc: You are fully healed, players nearby with you
totem.imprint.escape.desc: A leap out of the fight, then briefly invisible
totem.imprint.souls.desc: Iron golems guard you until the time runs out
totem.imprint.guard.desc: Long resistance and absorption instead of the short one
totem.imprint.revenge.desc: The attacker gets back what they dealt out
totem.msg.redeemed: The shards became a new totem.
totem.msg.no_material: You are missing the material for that.
totem.msg.no_shards: You have too few shards for that.
totem.msg.no_store: The imprint could not be stored on the totem - your material is untouched.
totem.rule.autoOffhand: Totem into the off hand when in danger
be.feature.legacy.desc: Cycles, secret roles and global tasks - a project for weeks
legacy.body.running: Work on the open tasks. Every contribution is recorded separately.
legacy.body.idle: No cycle is running. An operator starts it.
legacy.btn.deliver.hint: Material from your inventory into the shared system
legacy.tasks.body: The progress belongs to everyone, your contribution counts for you.
legacy.tasks.none: No task is open right now.
legacy.deliver.body: Pick a stack - it moves into the system completely.
legacy.deliver.none: Nothing in your inventory that an open task could use.
legacy.vault.body: Everything here belongs to everyone. Tap to withdraw.
legacy.role.reveal: Your role is secret. Is anyone looking over your shoulder?
legacy.msg.soon: This area is coming in a later stage.
legacy.msg.cycle_start: Cycle %1 begins. %2 players have a new role.
legacy.err.vault_empty: There is none of that left.
legacy.op.title: Game master
legacy.op.body: Here you see and set everything. Operators only.
legacy.op.start.confirm: A cycle is already running. Restarting resets all tasks and hands out new roles.
legacy.op.resettasks.confirm: Progress and all contributions will be lost. Sure?
legacy.op.roles.body: Only you see this list. Tap to change a role.
legacy.op.assign.body: Which role should this player get?
legacy.op.pool.body: %1 special roles are handed out. The traitor is always in, the rest become citizens.
legacy.op.tasks.body: Set a target, switch off, reset - and see who did how much.
legacy.op.players.body: Points, contributions and status of all known players.
legacy.role.traitor.desc: The secret opposition. Own tasks, sabotage and manipulation.
legacy.role.mayor.desc: A stronger vote and a special election function.
legacy.role.treasurer.desc: With enough progress, spots bribed players.
legacy.role.fool.desc: Wants to be voted out and sows doubt.
legacy.role.seer.desc: With enough progress, checks a player's role.
legacy.role.hacker.desc: Can end or block a system fault.
legacy.role.recorder.desc: Retrieves log data such as last seen times.
legacy.role.detective.desc: Learns the times of deaths and can read them.
legacy.role.victim.desc: If eliminated by the traitor, the traitor is revealed publicly.
legacy.role.guardian_angel.desc: Killed by the traitor he becomes a spectator and can protect others.
legacy.role.bodyguard.desc: Picks a target and protects it.
legacy.role.sheriff.desc: Can eliminate the traitor in combat - a wrong shot is costly.
legacy.role.double_agent.desc: You stand between the fronts: side with the town - or offer your services to the traitor. The seer sees whatever disguise you choose.
legacy.role.citizen.desc: No special ability, but every vote and every contribution counts.
legacy.task.stock.desc: Food into the shared system so nobody starves.
legacy.task.timber.desc: Logs and planks for everything that gets built.
legacy.task.forge.desc: Iron ingots into the shared system.
legacy.task.foundation.desc: Place blocks - any kind, as long as it grows.
legacy.task.coalseam.desc: Coal and charcoal into the shared system.
legacy.task.vermin.desc: Kill monsters so the night becomes bearable.
legacy.task.survey.desc: Cover distance together and open up the world.
legacy.task.abyss.desc: Push below Y -50 - each player counts once.
legacy.task.nethergate.desc: Enter the Nether - each player counts once.
legacy.task.hellharvest.desc: Contribute nether quartz and nether wart.
legacy.task.beasthunt.desc: Kill blazes, wither skeletons, piglin brutes and hoglins.
legacy.task.netheritecore.desc: Contribute netherite ingots - the heart of the legacy.
legacy.vote.none: No vote is running right now.
legacy.vote.body: Choose a name – or skip if you do not want to vote anyone out. You may change your mind while the vote runs.
legacy.vote.emergency: Emergency vote! Choose a name or skip.
legacy.emergency.body: %1 emergency votes are left this cycle. Each player may call at most one per cycle.
legacy.emergency.confirm: This cannot be undone. %1 will be left afterwards, and yours is used up.
legacy.msg.vote_none: A tie - nobody is voted out.
legacy.msg.fool: %1 was the fool - being voted was the goal. They won and stay in the game.
legacy.msg.victim: The victim has fallen - the traitor was %1.
legacy.msg.successor: The traitor is dead. Someone else carries on the work ...
legacy.msg.successor_gone: Your successor is out of the game. Name a new one.
legacy.msg.no_successor: You have not named a successor yet. If you fall, chance decides.
legacy.msg.successor_set: %1 is now your successor. They know nothing about it.
legacy.msg.shine: The legacy shines. Cycle %1 has ended.
legacy.msg.angel: %1 was the guardian angel. Before leaving for %2 hours, they choose two players to protect.
legacy.msg.saved: %1 was spared by a guardian angel.
legacy.msg.released: Your timeout is over. Welcome back.
legacy.msg.spectator: Timeout: %1 minutes left. You are a spectator until then.
legacy.msg.spectator_out: You are eliminated and remain a spectator.
legacy.err.no_vote: No vote is running right now.
legacy.err.not_alive: You are not in play right now.
legacy.err.not_candidate: That player cannot be voted for.
legacy.err.emergency_used: You have already used your emergency vote.
legacy.op.vote.body: The vote is running. The current tally is below.
legacy.op.vote.reset.confirm: All emergency votes of this cycle will be available again, for every single player too. (A new cycle refills them anyway.)
legacy.body.storm: The Black Night. %1 minutes left - nobody comes through it.
legacy.ability.body: %1 contribution points available. Work on global tasks recharges them.
legacy.ability.passive: Your role works in the background - it needs no button.
legacy.ability.sabotage.body: Only one runs at a time. The hacker can end it.
legacy.ability.successor.desc: Who carries on your work if you fall - chosen once, final. They learn nothing; only in the next cycle do they wake up as the traitor.
legacy.ability.mark.desc: Decide who you want to take out of the game. Only this player is eliminated by your hand - you may change it any time, but the bodyguard finds out.
legacy.ability.bribe.desc: Offer 128 diamonds - costs you nothing, whoever accepts cannot vote for you
legacy.ability.phantom.desc: Turn invisible and appear under someone else's name
legacy.ability.sabotage.desc: Trigger a blackout, a system fault or a dark night
legacy.ability.inspect_vote.desc: See who voted for whom - in the running vote, otherwise the last one
legacy.ability.false_trail.desc: Spread an anonymous suspicion in chat
legacy.ability.check_role.desc: Reveal the role of one player
legacy.ability.repair.desc: End a running sabotage at once
legacy.ability.last_seen.desc: Who is online and since when - who was here last, when and for how long
legacy.ability.death_log.desc: The last deaths with time and culprit
legacy.ability.protect.desc: After the traitor takes you: choose two players who are shielded from them once
legacy.ability.watch.desc: You learn when your target is struck by the traitor
legacy.ability.shoot.desc: Accuse a player and then kill them yourself. If it is the traitor, they are out - otherwise you are gone for long.
legacy.sabotage.blackout.desc: Nobody can see much any more
legacy.sabotage.darknight.desc: 45 minutes of night, monsters far stronger
legacy.bribe.title: An offer
legacy.bribe.body: Someone offers you %1 diamonds. Accept and you learn who it is - and may no longer vote for them.
legacy.bribe.waiting: An offer is waiting for you
legacy.bribe.confirm: Afterwards you cannot vote against this player. Sure?
legacy.msg.bribe_sent: %1 diamonds are on their way to %2.
legacy.msg.immunity: Something was moved inside the system ...
legacy.msg.sabotage: Something is wrong in the system - %1 minutes.
legacy.msg.mark_seen: The traitor has set his sights on %1.
legacy.msg.mark_none: The traitor has not settled on anyone yet.
legacy.err.target_gone: That one is out of the game.
legacy.msg.watch_hit: Your charge %1 was struck by the traitor!
legacy.msg.sheriff_bad: That was not the traitor. You are out for %1 hours.
legacy.msg.guardian: %1 is the Guardian of the Legacy.
legacy.msg.newcomers: New players are on their way ...
legacy.msg.black_night_end: The Black Night takes whoever is still standing.
legacy.msg.cycle_ban: Whoever fell in the Black Night stays out for %1 hours - then a new role awaits.
legacy.msg.joined: %1 has joined and been given a role.
legacy.msg.still_combat: You are still in combat - %1 seconds left.
legacy.err.no_cp: You are missing points for that.
legacy.err.no_diamonds: You do not have that many diamonds.
legacy.err.bribe_open: An offer is already waiting there.
legacy.err.bribed: You cannot vote against that player.
legacy.err.protect_full: More than two is not possible.
legacy.rule.darkNightChance: Dark night on its own (% per day)
legacy.rule.cycleBanHours: Timeout after dying in the Black Night (hours)

legacy.ability.choose_side.desc: The town - or, if they agree, the traitor. Once you may defect from them back to the town.
legacy.ability.whisper.desc: Write to the traitor anonymously. They cannot see who sent it.
legacy.ability.mask.desc: Pick which role the seer sees when checking you.
legacy.ability.unmask.desc: Find out which name the traitor is currently wearing while phantom walking.

legacy.ability.reply.desc: Answer whoever last wrote to you anonymously.

legacy.mission.stall: The task %2 must not be finished by the end of day %4.

legacy.agent.side.body.none: You have not committed yet. Orders come from both sides but pay only half. The town takes you right away - the traitor has to agree and only sees your record, never your name.
legacy.agent.side.body.town: You work for the town. That holds until the end of the cycle.
legacy.agent.side.body.traitor: You work for the traitor and cannot vote against them. Once you may defect to the town - then they learn your name.
legacy.agent.record: Record: %1 for the shadow · %2 for the council · %3 failed
legacy.agent.no_mission: No order right now. The next one comes unannounced.
legacy.agent.choose.town.confirm: Work for the town? That holds until the end of the cycle.
legacy.agent.choose.traitor: Offer your services to the traitor
legacy.agent.choose.traitor.confirm: Offer to work for the traitor? They only see your record. If they agree, you learn their name - and can no longer vote against them.
legacy.agent.choose.defect.confirm: Really defect? It only works once - and the traitor learns who you are the moment you do.
legacy.agent.mask.body: This is what the seer sees when checking you. They do not learn that you wear a disguise.
legacy.agent.requests.body: Someone is offering you their services. You will not learn who - only what they have done so far.
legacy.agent.answer.body: A stranger wants to work for you. Done: %1 for you · %2 for the town · %3 failed. If you accept, they learn your name. You never learn theirs.
legacy.agent.order.body: What should your agent do? They get the order without either of you seeing the other.
legacy.agent.order.diamonds: Pay in diamonds (held back right away)
legacy.agent.msg.request: A stranger is offering you their services. Check your abilities.
legacy.agent.msg.accepted: The traitor has accepted you. It is %1.
legacy.agent.msg.declined: The traitor declined. You can try again tomorrow at the earliest.
legacy.agent.msg.request_expired: Your request to the traitor expired without an answer.
legacy.agent.msg.defected: Your agent has defected to the town. It was %1.
legacy.agent.msg.covered: Someone is covering for you: the seer's next check on you shows "Citizen".
legacy.agent.msg.mission_void: Order expired, it never came to it:
legacy.agent.msg.order_failed: Your agent failed the order. The diamonds go back to you.
legacy.agent.msg.order_void: Your order expired. The diamonds go back to you.
legacy.agent.msg.loyalty: The traitor survived another day: +%1 CP
legacy.agent.msg.rejected: Declined. They will not learn who you are.
legacy.agent.msg.side_town: You now work for the town.
legacy.agent.msg.defect_done: You have defected. The traitor now knows who you are.
legacy.agent.msg.requested: Your request is with the traitor.
legacy.agent.msg.whisper_sent: The message is in the dead drop.
legacy.agent.msg.reply_sent: Your reply is in the dead drop.
legacy.agent.msg.mask_set: The seer now sees you as: %1
legacy.agent.msg.unmask: The traitor is currently appearing as %1.
legacy.agent.msg.unmask_none: The traitor is not wearing a mask right now.
legacy.agent.msg.cover_given: Cover given. The traitor only knows that someone is covering for them.
legacy.agent.msg.order_given: The order is on its way.
legacy.err.request_open: Your request is still with the traitor.
legacy.err.no_traitor: There is no traitor right now.
legacy.err.not_servant: For that you have to work for the traitor.
legacy.err.no_contact: Nobody has written to you yet.
legacy.err.order_running: Your agent already has an order from you.
legacy.err.cover_used: The cover has been used up.
legacy.err.no_mission: That order is not possible right now.
legacy.err.agent_bound: You cannot vote against the one you serve.
legacy.op.agent.none: There is no double agent in this cycle.
legacy.op.agent.dropbox.body: Everything that went back and forth between agent and traitor:
legacy.rule.missionGapDays: Pause between orders (up to ... game days)
legacy.err.nothing: There is nothing left to do for that.
be.feature.guide.desc: Everything about this add-on to read up on - everyone gets it on their first join
be.feature.playtime.desc: Daily playtime credited at midnight; leftovers carry over to the next day
playtime.body: Balance: %1. Every day at midnight %2 minutes are added, even when you are offline - next time in %3. Whatever you do not use stays yours.
playtime.body.free: No daily playtime applies to you.
playtime.msg.spectator: Your playtime is used up. Until new time arrives in %1 you can only spectate.
playtime.op.body.off: Switched off. When switched on, everyone starts with today's time.
playtime.rule.fixedHours: Fixed offset from UTC (hours, only for "fixed")
bounty.msg.yoursClaimed: Your bounty on %1 was claimed by %2.
legacy.rule.passiveCp: CP per minute of playtime (0 = off)
legacy.rule.passiveCap: Maximum playtime CP per day (0 = unlimited)
legacy.rule.passiveAfk: Only players who move (5 minutes idle = no points)
legacy.role.passive.cap: From playtime today: %1 CP, %2 more possible
playtime.cfg.hud: Playtime in the action bar (the last 5 minutes always)
legacy.successor.title: Your successor
legacy.successor.body: You are the traitor. Choose now who carries on your work if you fall. They will not know. The choice is final - you cannot change it. Only if your successor drops out of the game do you choose again.
legacy.successor.confirm: %1 becomes your successor. This cannot be changed. Are you sure?
legacy.err.successor_locked: Your successor is set - the choice cannot be changed.
legacy.rule.playerTimeoutHours: Timeout after being killed by a player (hours)
legacy.msg.welcome_back: Your timeout is over - welcome back to cycle %1, day %2.
carry.err.double_chest: A double chest cannot be carried - the other half's contents would be lost.
legacy.err.item_gone: That item is no longer in its slot.
treecap.rule.naturalOnly: Real trees only (natural leaves on the trunk)
treecap.msg.notTree: Not a tree - no natural leaves on the trunk. Just this block.
inv.rule.ownOnly: Only stash into your own and your clan's chests
inv.err.no_own_container: None of the chests nearby are yours. Others stay untouched; an old chest belongs to whoever opens it first.
legacy.err.vault_full: No more room in the system for this - too many special pieces of this kind. It stays in your inventory.
legacy.err.angel_only: You can only protect in the minutes after the traitor has taken you.
legacy.msg.accused: You accuse %1. You have %2 minutes to kill them yourself.
legacy.msg.fool_paid: You won as the fool: %1 diamonds.
legacy.rule.foolDiamonds: Fool's reward when voted (diamonds, once per cycle)
legacy.op.game.body: On a server, players arrive one by one. Start puts everyone into survival mode and hands out the starter kit – including anyone who joins for the first time later. That registers them. You hand out the roles afterwards, once everyone is there.
legacy.op.game.lobby.on: Lobby: on – adventure mode, no movement, no hunger, no death (operators stay free)
legacy.op.game.start.confirm: Everyone present, and everyone who joins later, is set to survival mode and gets %1 golden carrots. You hand out the roles afterwards.
legacy.op.game.reset.confirm: The game counts as not started again, and the lobby applies again. On the next start everyone gets survival mode and the starter kit again.
legacy.rule.lobby: Lobby before the start (adventure, no movement, no hunger, no death)
legacy.rule.startCarrots: Golden carrots in the starter kit
legacy.msg.game_start: The game begins! Everyone is set to survival mode and gets a starter kit. Roles are handed out once everyone is here.
legacy.msg.welcome: Welcome to the game! You are in survival mode and got %1 golden carrots.
legacy.msg.lobby: You are in the lobby. Wait until the game starts.
legacy.msg.strike: Death %1 of %2 today – no consequences yet. Death number %2 on one day costs a %3 hour timeout.
legacy.msg.angel_done: You now protect: %1. The protection keeps working while you are away.
legacy.msg.angel_none: You chose nobody and are leaving now.
legacy.angel.title: Guardian angel
legacy.angel.body: You have fallen. Choose %1 more players to shield once from the traitor – even after you are gone. %2 min left.
legacy.msg.outsider: Your ban is over. You are eliminated and play on as a normal player – no role, nothing to do with the legacy.
legacy.body.outsider: You are eliminated. In this game there is no role, no tasks, no points and no votes for you any more – you play on as a normal player.
legacy.err.outsider: You are eliminated and no longer contribute to the legacy.
legacy.rule.keepOut: Eliminated players stay out for the whole game
legacy.rule.angelMinutes: Time the fallen guardian angel has to choose (minutes)
legacy.rule.deathStrikes: Timeout only on death number ... per day (without players)
legacy.gate.closed: %1 is still sealed – %2 more hours of combined playtime of all players are needed.
legacy.gate.locked: %1 has been sealed by the operator.
legacy.gate.opened: %1 has opened! The combined playtime of all players was enough.
legacy.op.gates.body: Combined playtime of all players: %1 h. Counted from the server start, without a server start from the first cycle.
legacy.op.gates.switch: Tap to switch: by playtime → open → sealed.
legacy.op.gates.off: The seal is switched off – Nether and End are open.
legacy.rule.gates: Open Nether and End only after combined playtime
legacy.op.timeout.done: %1 is now in a timeout for %2 hours.
legacy.op.eliminate.confirm: %1 is eliminated: banned for %2 hours, then a normal player without a role – for the whole game.
be.feature.admin.desc: Bans, players, world, log – operators only
admin.title: Admin tools

admin.players.body: Whoever is online is at the top. ⛔ banned · ❄ frozen · ⚠ warnings
admin.world.body: Time, weather, cleanup, broadcast, game rules and world spawn.
admin.maintenance.confirm: Only operators may join. Everyone else online is kicked right away.
admin.maintenance.off: Maintenance mode off – everyone may join again.
admin.inv.body: Tap to move the stack into your inventory. Light blue: armor and offhand.
admin.kick.failed: %1 could not be kicked (host of a local world?).
admin.unbanned: The ban of %1 has been lifted.
admin.clear.confirm: Delete the whole inventory and armor of %1? This cannot be undone.
admin.clearlag.confirm: Remove all dropped items and experience orbs in every dimension?
admin.broadcast.title: Also big on screen
admin.spawn.confirm: The world spawn will be set to your position.
admin.cmd.self: You cannot do that to yourself.
legacy.vote.skip.name: Skip

be.feature.web.desc: Link to the website: status, chronicle and map

web.op.map: Map: %1 · %2 chunks queued · %3 waiting to be sent
web.title: Bedrock Essentials
web.gates.allopen: No seal – Nether and End are open.

web.map.empty: Nothing explored yet – the map fills up as soon as someone plays.

web.err.not_member: You are not in a clan.

web.login.step2: Enter the code here. It is valid for ten minutes and only once – if it says "wrong", wait a few seconds and try again: the server reports new codes every 15 seconds.
web.login.bad: The code is wrong or has expired – brand-new codes only reach the site after a few seconds.
web.login.too_many: Too many attempts – please wait a minute.

web.link.nobridge: No website is connected to the server right now.
web.profile.queued: Waiting until you are in the game
web.profile.waiting: Your data is on its way – the server sends it with its next message.

web.legacy.vote.confirm: Your vote goes to: %1. You can change it while the vote runs.

web.market.unknown_item: I do not know “%1” – try the ID, e.g. minecraft:diamond.
web.market.none: There are no offers right now.

web.market.accept.gift: A gift – the goods go to your inventory (or the mailbox).
web.market.cancel.confirm: The items go back to you.
web.clans.none_mine: You are not in a clan.

web.clans.name: Name
web.bounty.text: Whoever takes out the target gets the items.
web.bounty.none: There is no bounty on anyone.

web.admin.ban.name: Ban a player …
web.admin.unban.name: Unban a player …
web.admin.maintenance.confirm: Only operators may join. Everyone else is kicked right away.
web.admin.clearlag.confirm: Remove all dropped items and experience orbs in every dimension?

web.players.note.sent: Message to %1 is on its way.
web.players.gift.title: Gift for %1

web.admin.freeze.hint: They stay frozen when they come back.
web.admin.clearinv.confirm: Delete the whole inventory and armour of %1? This can't be undone.
web.admin.later: Noted – happens as soon as %1 joins the server.
web.admin.later.hint: Offline: happens the next time they join.

web.login.password.text: With your player name and password – from any device, even while you're not playing.
